commander_web_llm_contract: The commander may choose to create the cover in a web LLM/image tool instead of using the local agent. In that mode, cover-maker does not force local generation; it records the chosen mode, waits for commander-provided cover files or QC direction, and still requires final 16:9 and 9:16 outputs plus commander QC before pipeline completion.
candidate_set_contract: Each default cover generation run must produce 3 candidate sets unless the commander explicitly requests a different count. Each candidate set contains one 16:9 cover and one 9:16 cover, sharing the same subject/person, background, color palette, lighting mood, title semantics, and typography direction. Commander QC selects one candidate set, requests revisions, or rejects all.

cover_type_routing_policy.rule: The subject is a replaceable asset. A face photo, screenshot, woman, man, product, or other approved subject never changes background, typography, or template routing. Use white_editorial unless the commander explicitly selects dark_face.

commander_face_identity_policy.rule: When the commander explicitly requests a commander-face subject, use the commander's real face image before a generic AI face. This policy selects identity only. It must not select dark_face or override white_editorial; cover_type routing remains explicit.

default_style_profile.description: Default safe cover style: white / near-white background, oversized black Chinese title, title-serif typography, subject/person as supporting visual, no small branding text.
default_style_profile.title_rule: Cover title is the only required text by default. Use large black Chinese title text as the visual center. Do not add channel names, episode labels, slogans, watermarks, or other small branding text unless the operator explicitly asks.
default_style_profile.layout_rule: Default layout follows the white editorial pattern: title dominates the readable area, person/subject supports the right/lower side, and 16:9 / 9:16 share the same subject, background, palette, and lighting.
default_style_profile.override_rule: Commander instruction in the current run may override this default style only by explicitly selecting another cover_type. A provided face, screenshot, or subject image never changes the style by itself.

aspect_consistency_contract: Reference templates are inspiration only. Generated cover_16x9 and cover_9x16 must keep the same subject/person, background scene, color palette, lighting mood, and title semantics; only layout, composition, and canvas aspect ratio may differ.
rule: Cover title fields come from the user-specified script via the approved B-Roll design, not from the human-refined transcript.
